name: devo6-workflow-doc-tooling
description: Repository-local Markdown lint tooling for Devo6.WorkFlow.

scripts.lint:md: npm run lint:md:text && npm run lint:md:spell && npm run lint:md:whitelist
scripts.lint:md:text: node tools/lint/run-skill-script.js review-enforcer/scripts/list-markdown-targets.js --print0 | xargs -0 -r textlint --config .textlintrc.json --rulesdir "$(node tools/lint/run-skill-script.js --print-path review-enforcer/scripts/textlint-rules)"
